title: Consent of another county.
bodyText: No county shall construct an undertaking or administer a loan program wholly or partly within the corporate limits of another county except with the consent of the governing body of the other county.
bodyHtml: §49-22  Consent of another county.  No county shall construct an undertaking or administer a loan program wholly or partly within the corporate limits of another county except with the consent of the governing body of the other county. [L 1989, c 80, pt of §3]
